name: Navidrome
summary: Your own music, with the streaming-service experience and no music subscription.

catalog.description: Give the music you have collected over the years the streaming-service experience. Navidrome turns your albums, downloads and ripped CDs into a personal music service, with an artwork-rich library, instant search, playlists and favourites. Listen from your browser, phone or compatible speakers, with your files on your own server and no music subscription needed for your collection.

features.title: Your own personal streaming service
features.body: Put years of collected music back into everyday listening. Find an old favourite in seconds, explore an artist's albums and build a queue for the evening in a familiar streaming interface, powered by the files you already own.

features.title: Keep your collection without a monthly music bill
features.body: Bring your purchased downloads, ripped CDs and rare recordings into one library. Your files stay on your drive, and listening to your own collection needs no Spotify or Apple Music subscription.

features.title: Take your library beyond your server
features.body: Connect a compatible phone or desktop player and carry your collection with you. Clients with offline downloads let you take albums on a flight or keep listening without a connection; availability and pricing depend on the player you choose.

features.title: Play to Sonos and AirPlay speakers
features.body: Let your own collection fill the house. Use a compatible client such as Symfonium for Sonos, or an AirPlay-capable iPhone, iPad or Mac player for supported speakers. These clients are installed separately.

features.title: Bring your collection and streaming accounts together
features.body: Want one player for owned music and streaming services? A separate client such as Ampcast can connect Navidrome alongside Spotify, Apple Music and YouTube. Each service’s account and subscription requirements still apply.

features.title: Make your collection feel alive
features.body: Choose online artwork and artist information to enrich your library, and connect Last.fm or ListenBrainz to keep a listening history. MOS disables usage reporting; the music integrations remain your choice.

resourceHint.label: Light resources
resourceHint.description: A small music server between visits; scanning a large collection and converting audio use more memory and processor time.

privacy.summary: MOS disables usage reporting. Online metadata and artwork are your choice at installation; sharing listening history requires connecting an account yourself in Navidrome.
notes: MOS explicitly disables Gravatar and anonymous usage reporting and supplies no Google Analytics tracking ID. Online metadata is enabled by default and can be unchecked during installation; music services receive lookup terms and your server address.
ListenBrainz listening-history sharing starts only after you enable it in Personal Settings and enter your token. Last.fm sharing similarly requires account authorisation and server API credentials.
The sign-in page uses the shared MOS wallpaper, with no background-image download. Plugins remain available; plugins or radio streams you add can contact their own services.
Phone and desktop clients have their own privacy settings. MOS backs up playlists and settings; music on your drive needs a separate backup.

fields.label: Fetch online metadata and artwork. Allow music services to receive artist and album lookups; music playback and ListenBrainz sharing work without these lookups.

storage.label: Drive for your music
storage.description: Navidrome plays the music you add to this drive.

onboarding.title: Listen to your music
onboarding.summary: Your administrator is ready. Add your music to the drive to start listening.

sections.title: Sign in
sections.body: Open Navidrome and use the username and password you chose during installation.

sections.title: Add your collection
sections.body: In Settings → Storage, browse the drive and add your music under MOS-files, apps, navidrome, Music. Or eject the drive, copy music there from another computer, and reconnect it. Albums appear after scanning; tags and artwork in your files organise the library.

sections.title: Keep another copy of your music
sections.body: MOS backs up accounts, playlists and settings. Music on the drive is not included.

values.label: Password
values.value: Use the Navidrome password you chose during installation.
